forbidden_use: Do not score candidates seeded from these rows by signature reversal / opposition of the IT7 P3 readout (SLC2A1, HK2, LDHA, LDHB, BNIP3 up; PDK1 down) or any set containing it: the readout was opened in IT7 and is the seed itself
Do not score candidates by reversal of an ISR transcript set (SET:ISR_TARGETS_12, CHAC1, TRIB3, SESN2, PSAT1, ATF5, ATF4 mRNA) until the human ISR sign is resolved

The row is a state whose magnitude/rate is an evaluation endpoint of reserved rows: the generator may use the presence and direction, evaluation must use the reserved magnitude rows, and a candidate must not be scored on the quantity this row's seed came from without a fresh measurement
scope_members: burst frequency, seizure/SWD rate, firing rate, myelinated-axon count, GFAP/IBA1 area and counts
